jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About BRAINS**  
BRAINS is an independent creative agency and proud B-Corp. We're a group of no-a\*\*hole, roll-up-our-sleeves creatives, united by a mission to spark market and cultural impact and connect people around shared values and passions. We partner with mission-driven brands looking to rethink and rewrite industry norms.

### **Project Manager (Contract-to-Hire)**

**Reports to:** Creative Ops Lead  
**Direct Reports:** None  
**Position Type:** Contract-to-hire. 3 month contract with the intent to convert to a full-time role  
**Classification:** 1099 contract employee of BRAINS  
**Schedule:** Starting part time at 20-30 hours per week  
**Location:** Remote

**About the Role**  
The Project Manager runs day-to-day project operations, coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring deliverables meet client expectations on time and within budget. This is an agency role: you'll manage several client projects at once in a fast-moving, client-service environment, so prior agency experience is required. The primary focus of this role will be a high-volume retainer client with a variety of task types and workstreams. The role starts as a 3-month contract, and we plan to convert it to a full-time position at BRAINS for the right person.  
  
***Due to client and team, candidates in the Pacific Time zone are strongly preferred for this position.***

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Leadership & Delivery**

* Create and maintain project timelines and scopes of work.
* Define clear project plans, track milestones, and anticipate risks to ensure smooth delivery.
* Monitor progress and escalate risks/issues as needed.
* Lead status meetings and project check-ins.
* Maintain visibility across multiple workstreams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with agency quality standards.

**Team Operations & Collaboration**

* Manage resourcing across assigned projects, ensuring workloads are balanced.
* Facilitate communication between account, creative, and production teams.
* Partner closely with account leads, strategists, and creatives to align project delivery with strategic objectives.
* Identify and escalate blockers for assigned project teams, ensuring momentum and accountability throughout the lifecycle of a project.

**Budgeting & Reporting**

* Collaborate closely with account leads to align on budgets and schedules.
* Track and report on project performance metrics.

**Who You Are**

* **A Systems Thinker**  
  You’re fluent in designing workflows that balance structure with flexibility and know how to keep teams aligned and focused.
* **An Operational Strategist**  
  You understand how delivery, process, and planning intersect with business health, client satisfaction, and creative excellence.
* **A Skilled Communicator**  
  You bring clarity, empathy, and precision to how you communicate, whether with clients, internal teams, or team leadership.
* **A Confident Problem-Solver**  
  You stay calm under pressure and have a knack for untangling complexity, resolving issues, and keeping momentum.

**Experience**

* **Required:** 3–5 years of agency project management experience, ideally in a creative/advertising environment. In-house or brand-side project management experience alone won't be a fit for this role.
* Hands-on experience running agency client work: scopes of work, retainer and project budgets, client approvals, and creative review rounds across multiple accounts at once.
* Advanced knowledge of project management tools. BRAINS uses Asana for project management.
* Strong understanding of creative processes (digital, motion, print, production, etc.).
* Excellent multitasking, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.

**Contract-to-Hire Details**

* **Initial Contract length:** 3 months
* **Contract pay:** $60-80 per hour, paid every two weeks.
* **Full-time salary on conversion:** $65,000- $85,000 per year, based on location and experience.
* **Benefits after conversion:** Eligible for BRAINS’ full-time benefits, including health, dental, PTO, 401(k), etc.
* **How conversion works:** Near the end of the contract, we’ll review performance, fit, and business needs together. If it’s a match, we’ll extend a full-time offer. While conversion to full time is our intent, it isn’t guaranteed.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Media
jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  
Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  
**What to Expect:**  
At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  
**How You’ll Contribute:**  
Project manager (PM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiating through Closing phases. However, the PM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project manager’s role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders.
  
  
The PM is responsible for overseeing, and performing project management functions on all M&E projects, budgets and scopes. The PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for technicians, managing deliverables from engineering, CAD and Programming and overseeing the completion of projects. The PM is responsible for completing systems integration projects on time, on budget and achieving high customer satisfaction from our customers. The majority of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes.
* As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long-term relationship. He manages the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.
* Coordinates and communicates.
* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders. Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to M&E installation projects.
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments.
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, installation technicians, subcontractors, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor, equipment and materials budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members.
* Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Performs field verification of prospective work site. Documents all issues with site and keeps everyone informed of potential issues and solutions.
* Coordinates all drawings and documentation between all internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitates and directs design reviews to assure proper documentation in the field.
* Coordinates all system programming and final checkout of systems. Provides punch-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors and other trades when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates training & turnover of projects to client, service department, & sales.

**Complexity:**  

* Every project is different, and every set of project stakeholders is different. The PM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between system design, site conditions and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence and people management skills. The PM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project.
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.

•

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee.
* The employee may be exposed to construction site conditions on a regular basis. Employee will be responsible for their safety while on job sites and to comply with all safety regulations in place by the GC. Use of PPE is usually required on job sites.

jobs.description:
**Project Manager – Proposals**

Spark Power Corp USA is seeking an organized and detail-oriented **Project Manager – Proposals** who will be responsible for coordinating the preparation, development, and timely submission of customer proposals in support of our Major Projects division. This role will work closely with internal estimating teams, operational leadership, and customers to ensure proposals are accurate, complete, and aligned with customer requirements and submission deadlines.

Our ideal **Project Manager – Proposals** candidate will be a highly organized, motivated individual with excellent communication and interpersonal skills who is comfortable managing multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. This position combines proposal coordination, customer relationship management, and administrative project support. The successful candidate will serve as a key point of contact between customers and internal teams, helping ensure proposals move efficiently from the estimating stage through final submission.

**What will you do in this position?**

**Proposal Development & Coordination**

* Coordinate the preparation, review, and submission of proposals for electrical construction and infrastructure projects within the Major Projects division.
* Work closely with the estimating team to gather project estimates, supporting documentation, and other information required to develop customer proposals.
* Utilize established company proposal templates to prepare professional, accurate, and complete proposal packages.
* Review estimates, proposal documents, and customer requirements to ensure all requested information, scope details, and deliverables are properly addressed.
* Coordinate revisions and updates to proposals based on feedback from customers, estimating teams, and internal leadership.

**Customer Relations & Communication**

* Assist leadership with customer follow-ups and ongoing communication related to active proposals and potential projects.

* Track and manage multiple active proposals, bid deadlines, and customer submission requirements.
* Maintain organized records of proposal statuses, due dates, revisions, and outstanding action items.
* Coordinate with estimators and internal stakeholders to ensure required information is received and incorporated into proposals on schedule.
* Identify potential delays or challenges that could impact proposal deadlines and communicate concerns proactively.
* Prioritize competing deadlines and assist with adjusting schedules or coordinating customer extensions when necessary.

jobs.title: Deputy Project Manager
jobs.description:
### **General Information**

Position Title

Deputy Project Manager

Job Category

Project & Programme Management

Duty Station(s)

Home based

Seniority Level

Mid Level

ICS Level

ICS 09

Contract Type

ICA - IICA - Regular

Contract Level

IICA 1

Posting Start Date

17-Nov-2026

Posting End Date

24-Nov-2026

Duration

Open-ended subject to organizational requirements, availability of funds and/or satisfactory performance

### **Job Highlight**

Facilitate the delivery of transactional services across HR, procurement, and grants management in a global operating environment.

### **About the Region**

The UNOPS Global Portfolios Office (GPO) brings together diverse expertise to help partners deliver impact worldwide. With hubs in New York, Geneva, and Vienna, and expert teams operating globally, GPO leads multi-regional initiatives that advance sustainable development, climate action, and peacebuilding - including in some of the world’s most challenging environments. By leveraging our collective expertise and global networks, GPO supports UNOPS’ strategic priorities and the Sustainable Development Goals across more than 130 countries. We work closely with major global partners - including governments, international financial institutions, and UN agencies - to deliver a wide range of services, such as project management, fund management, hosting services, and HR support.

### **About the Country/Multi-Country Office**

Not Required - part of GPO/NYPO

### **Job Specific Context**

UNOPS UNTSS and its project teams based at multiple locations around the world engage with UN System partners to support the implementation of their mandated activities in the realm of innovation and technology

### **Role Purpose**

Provide operational assistance and support in the delivery and day-to-day oversight of services for UNOPS partners, including HR, procurement, and grants management. The role involves coordination with donors, partners, and beneficiaries to ensure alignment with contractual commitments and UNOPS performance standards under the direction of the Project Manager. The Deputy Project Manager, acting on behalf of the Project Board, retains overall responsibility for the oversight and delivery of project outputs within agreed tolerances for time, cost, scope, quality, risk, and benefits.

### **Functions / Key Results Expected**

* **Project Delivery and Performance**

  

* Contribute to the development, execution and updating of detailed implementation plans, ensuring that all project outputs are delivered on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
  
* Integrate sustainability, social inclusion, and gender equality considerations into all project stages.
  
* Ensure that quality of work packages and deliverables comply with the quality requirements defined in the implementation plan.
  
* Liaise with external suppliers or account managers to ensure quality and timely delivery of outputs.
  
* Manage the acceptance and delivery of work packages.
  
* Monitor of project progress, tracking project variances (if any), and support change management.
  
* Identify, anticipate and advise the Project Manager on mitigating measures against project risks to maximize benefits to partners and stakeholders.
  
* Identify and report potential opportunities for UNOPS to the supervisor.

  
  

* **Procedures**

  

* Comply with the organization’s policies and standards, and ensure project information is kept updated in project management systems.
  
* Be aware of applicable local laws and regulations, and ensure adherence. This includes international regulations and standards, where applicable, as well as technical standards.
  
* Prepare and adapt all relevant plans for approval by the project board, and manage baselines
  
* Manage the reporting obligations defined in the implementation plan and legal agreements.
  
* Maintain project documentation in an orderly manner for accessibility and audit support when needed.
  
* Understand and apply the UNOPS financial rules and regulations. Be accountable for the use of delegation of authority (where applicable) and ensure compliance with relevant policies and standards of ethics.
  
* Provide a formal handover of the project to the closure manager when applicable.
  
* Support project audit activities, including planning, preparation and coordination during audits and follow-up on audit observations/ recommendations.

  
  

* **Monitoring and Reporting**

  

* Include a results framework and M&E plan in the project implementation plan with clearly defined indicators and agreed targets, ensure regular monitoring and tracking of project results.
  
* Prepare and issue regular project and financial reports in accordance with partner and UNOPS requirements for reporting.
  
* Regularly review project status and evaluate performance criteria (scope, cost, schedule, and quality)
  
* Maintain diaries and progress reports as required by UNOPS standard operating procedures.
  
* Provide routine oversight and analysis of delivery data within the dashboard system.
  
* Ensure all project team members track and regularly update milestones and targets for the duration of the project life span.

  
  

* **Stakeholder Engagement**

  

* Build and maintain productive relationships with national and local authorities, donors, partners, grantees, and other key stakeholders.
  
* Facilitate regular communication and coordination among programme teams and partners.
  
* Ensure stakeholders are informed of project progress, activities and results through timely and accurate information.
  
* Enable formulation of project communication plans and monitor effectiveness of project communications.
  
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement and communication, ensuring effective timing and interdependency management of communications. Ensure stakeholders are aware of project activities, progress, and exceptions, and are in a position to accept handover outputs.

jobs.title: Recognition Program Manager (contract)
jobs.description:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

**\*\*\*Remote role with a preference for a candidate in McLean, VA or EST\*\***  
  
Job Summary:  
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented professional to independently manage the end-to-end execution of Hilton's prestigious annual Summit Awards program, a formal recognition initiative celebrating top performers across the Global Brands, Commercial, Marketing, and Technology organizations. This role is central to ensuring the program runs smoothly and on schedule each year, requiring a proactive and resourceful individual who can coordinate complex workflows, manage multiple stakeholders, and deliver a seamless recognition experience from launch through closeout. This is an exciting opportunity to play a meaningful role in honoring excellence across a globally recognized hospitality brand.  
  
Responsibilities:  

* Plan, track, and manage the full awards cycle from initiation through program closeout
* Coordinate stakeholders and vendors to ensure alignment and timely execution across all program phases
* Prepare, validate, and manage program data and materials with a high degree of accuracy
* Administer nominations and decision-making workflows, ensuring processes are followed consistently
* Oversee winner communications, ensuring messaging is timely, accurate, and appropriately handled
* Manage award fulfillment logistics and support celebration planning and execution
* Identify and resolve operational issues proactively, managing risks and deadlines throughout the program lifecycle
* Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance program efficiency and effectiveness
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for the Summit Awards program, escalating key decisions to Hilton leadership as appropriate

  
Skills:  

* Exceptional organizational skills, detail orientation and ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder coordination and winner communications
* Proficiency in data management, including preparing, validating, and maintaining program data and materials
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across diverse stakeholder groups and manage vendor relationships
* Sound judgment in identifying and resolving operational issues and managing program risks
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining alignment with leadership priorities

* Process improvement and automation skills preferred
* Experience with awards, recognition programs, vendor management, or event coordination preferred

Qualifications:  

* 5+ years of program or project management experience, with demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, multi-phase initiatives

* Prior experience supporting recognition, awards, or employee engagement programs is preferred
* Experience working within large, matrixed organizations preferred
* Background in vendor coordination and event or fulfillment logistics preferred

Remote  
  

The client is seeking a Senior IT Program Manager to lead a complex, multi-year, multi-million dollar transformation program. The client Transformation Program consists of three interdependent initiatives**:** (1) Data Management, establishing enterprise data ownership, stewardship, governance, and a data integration and analytics platform; (2) PRISM, the replacement of the client's fully customized Offender Management System with a configurable commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) solution; and (3) Integrate Technologies, ensuring horizontal and systems integration, synchronization, and operability between the new capabilities and all other client applications, including parallel capabilities being delivered under other approved initiatives.
  
  
The Senior IT Program Manager will own program-level planning, governance, financial management, dependency management, and benefits realization across these initiatives, from current state through production launch and transition to operations. The Senior IT Program Manager provides direction to the project managers, business analysts, and vendor delivery teams assigned to each initiative, serves as the primary escalation point below executive leadership, and is accountable for delivering the program on schedule, within scope, and within budget.
  
  
At a high level, the resource will provide strategic leadership and program oversight, applying senior-level management capabilities, executive communication, financial management, and vendor and contract coordination to support the delivery of complex technology initiatives. The program will encompass cloud-based vendor software, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) solutions, and custom development efforts delivered through Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.

**Bilingual Intake Coordinator (English/Spanish)**  
Headstart Health | Fully Remote | Full-Time  
$55,000–$65,000 annually

Be the warm, welcoming first introduction to Headstart for families seeking autism care. You’ll help families feel heard, understand their next steps, and move through intake with personal, attentive support.

**Fluent spoken Spanish is required.** You’ll support families in both English and Spanish. We strongly prefer availability for a schedule of approximately **9 a.m.–6 p.m. Pacific Time or Mountain Time**.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* $55,000–$65,000 annual salary, based on relevant experience and qualifications.
* Fully remote, full-time position.
* Health-insurance reimbursement to help cover the cost of your coverage.
* Unlimited paid time off, coordinated with your manager to maintain team coverage.
* Close collaboration with the Lead Manager and operations team, with opportunities to develop your skills as Headstart grows.

**About Headstart Health**

Headstart Health helps Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) build and run independent autism-care practices. We support intake, credentialing, billing, and recruiting so clinicians can focus on providing care to children and families.

**About the Role**

You’ll guide families from their first conversation with Headstart through gathering records and preparing for insurance verification. You’ll answer questions, coordinate with referring offices, and keep next steps moving while making each interaction feel personal.

Working with our Lead Manager and Insurance Operations team, you’ll help resolve delays and prepare thoughtful handoffs. Families should know who to contact, understand what’s needed, and trust you to follow through.

**What You’ll Do**

* Welcome families, conduct scheduled intake calls, and follow up by phone, text, and email in English and Spanish.
* Listen to families’ questions, explain the intake process clearly, and keep them informed about next steps.
* Collect and track clinical, insurance, demographic, and intake documents; coordinate with families, referring offices, and schools to obtain missing records.
* Review referrals and faxes, document outreach and call outcomes, and maintain accurate Salesforce records.
* Help families complete portal setup and prepare organized handoffs to Insurance Operations.
* Flag stalled cases, time-sensitive needs, and complex questions to the Lead Manager, and suggest practical improvements to the family experience.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Required**

* Fluent spoken Spanish and strong English communication skills, including the ability to conduct a family intake conversation in either language.
* At least one year of experience in patient intake, care coordination, healthcare operations, or a similar frontline support role.
* A friendly, personable phone presence, strong listening skills, and comfort with frequent calls and outreach.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through across multiple families at different stages of intake.
* Comfort using digital tools, learning new systems, and handling confidential patient information.
* The ability to work independently, ask thoughtful questions, and adapt as processes evolve.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on Salesforce experience is a significant plus, especially managing leads, documenting outreach, and using task queues or reports. Experience with another CRM is also helpful.
* Experience in ABA, behavioral health, or pediatric healthcare.
* Familiarity with insurance eligibility, benefits verification, or payer documentation requirements.
* Experience with Aircall or similar phone systems, virtual fax tools, and Google Workspace.

**What Success Looks Like**

Families experience you as friendly, welcoming, and dependable. You remember the details, follow up when promised, and keep them informed when something is delayed. Your records are current and your handoffs give teammates the context they need to continue that care.

**How to Apply**

Submit your résumé. You’re welcome to include a brief note about your experience and interest in Headstart, but it isn’t required.

Part of the interview process will be conducted in Spanish with a fluent Spanish-speaking member of our team to assess how clearly and warmly you communicate with families.

We provide timely, scalable, evidence-based psychiatry and addiction care to individuals who

might otherwise face long wait times or significant travel barriers to receiving treatment.

* Excellent patient care
* Team well-being
* Lower total cost of care
* Improved population health
* Health equity

jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager
jobs.description:
**What is Reach Financial?**

Reach Financial is a FinTech platform helping people outsmart debt for good.

We are building innovative products and best-in-class support that enable our customers to take control of their debt and de-mystify their personal finances. Our products and tools empower our customers to turn their financial goals into a reality.

Reach Financial launched in 2015 and has helped our customers pay off over $1 billion in debt. We offer debt consolidation loans and personal loans; together, these markets represent a $1.5T opportunity. In time, we will expand beyond these products to offer solutions for a variety of our customers' personal finance challenges.

We are a fast-growing and fast-paced FinTech startup with the stability of an established firm. You will have a front-row seat at a rapidly growing company innovating the FinTech industry.

**About the Role**

The Customer Experience Manager leads frontline operations, ensuring the effective execution of departmental strategies, achievement of performance goals, and alignment with organizational priorities.

This role is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing Team Leads, overseeing employee performance management, maintaining quality and compliance standards, and optimizing workforce management. The Customer Experience Manager reports directly to the Director of Customer Experience.

**What You Will Do**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop Team Leads and Operations Specialists through biweekly 1:1s.
* Drive the weekly Team Lead meeting on performance trends, process fixes, and training gaps.

* Oversee formal corrective action and performance improvement plans in partnership with People & Culture, including appropriate documentation and escalation.
* Complete Team Lead reviews and support under-performing agent coaching.

**Operations & Workforce Management**

* Own daily operational execution, workload prioritization, scheduling, coverage, PTO, and timecard approvals. Delegate routine monitoring and follow-through to Team Leads.
* Assess demand, capacity, adherence, and coverage risks. Recommend staffing changes to the Director, who retains ownership of staffing forecasts and headcount decisions.
* Resolve second-level customer and operational escalations, document outcomes, and coordinate root-cause remediation with relevant partners.
* Maintain accurate procedures and knowledge resources. Obtain required approvals before publishing policy changes and coordinate training and implementation.

**Quality & Compliance**

* Calibrate QA scoring across the three teams, spot-check calls and emails for required disclosures, UDAAP language, and script adherence per bank partner expectations.
* Coordinate with Compliance, QA, and the Director to investigate exceptions, implement corrective actions, and verify remediation. Escalate significant customer, compliance, or operational risks promptly.

**Reporting & Performance**

* Own departmental KPI performance, including volume, abandon rate, QA, CSAT, AHT, ACW, Speed to Answer and Adherence.
* Validate and consolidate Team Lead reporting, maintain scorecards, and provide the Director with actionable findings, risks, and recommendations. Partner with relevant teams to resolve operational dependencies.
* Own performance improvement for quality, customer treatment, productivity, and employee development measures.
* Validate bonus calculations and supporting data, resolve discrepancies, and submit accurate results to designated recipients within established deadlines.

**What You Should Have**

* At least three years of customer service experience, including two years in a supervisory role, with demonstrated ownership of team performance and operational execution.
* Demonstrated ability to develop leaders, evaluate coaching effectiveness, administer corrective action with People & Culture, and maintain employee engagement.
* Experience in consumer loan servicing, working knowledge of UDAAP, regulatory complaint handling, and bank partner compliance expectations.
* Experience with workforce management and contact center tools (e.g., Amazon Connect, Salesforce, Rippling).
* Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills, including the ability to identify root causes, manage competing priorities, and drive actions to completion.

**What is it like working at Reach Financial?**

Our culture is built around advancing our teams, and we are dedicated to the success and growth of every team member. We believe in retaining a high-performing workforce and we prioritize diversity, intellectual curiosity, and continued learning. Our generous benefits packages reflect that.

We’ve been hard at work perfecting our product for years, and now we’re growing faster than ever before. Our strong foundation and company culture is readily equipped for this growth, and we believe that with the right people, our products will continue to help customers make real changes in their financial lives.

**What benefits will you receive?**

* Healthcare, Life Insurance, 401k Match
* Paid Time Off, Paid 12-week Parental Leave
* Disability (short-term, long-term), Employee Assistance Program
* Spending Accounts (Transit/Parking, Medical, Dependent Care)
* Insurance Discounts (home, auto, pet)

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 95,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: After Hours Call Center Manager
jobs.description:
You’re tired of managing a call center where your team is just headcount in a queue.

You want your leadership to matter, especially when the phones light up after hours.

You know how to coach CSRs, raise booking rates, and keep the floor moving under pressure.

### **If you thrive leading fast-paced evenings and weekends, this could fit you really well. Who We Are:**

Pink Callers is a ServiceTitan Certified Call Center built for HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical contractors. As our After Hours Call Center Manager, you'll help contractors stay responsive when their customers need them most.

We combine human skill with AI-driven efficiency, which means you won't be stuck doing mindless busywork all night. You'll be part of a team that values being proactive, transparent, problem-solving, leadership, and real teamwork.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

Your shift starts when many teams are winding down. You'll be the steady hand after hours, managing incoming calls and customer interactions when urgency is high and patience is low.

You'll talk with homeowners who need help now. You'll guide the conversation, create clarity, and turn that moment into a booked opportunity for our clients. When you do it well, families get help faster and contractors wake up to real business on the board.

This role matters because after-hours service is where trust is won or lost. If you like being the person who keeps things calm, sharp, and handled, you'll feel that here.

### **The Hiring Process**

We have a rigorous process for hiring, but move FAST for the right person. You could be hired in as little as 10 days! We've had lots of interest, so the first few steps are automated to make sure you can get considered quickly.

Don't worry—if you take the time to apply, we will respond to 100% of the applicants.

The process:

* Click apply and answer a few Who, What, When questions. (5 min)
* You'll be texted a link for a 10 min questionnaire that will help match you to the job (or others that might suit you!).
* You'll get a text for a quick 1-way video question. (5 min)
* We'll send you a link to get scheduled for an in-person interview.
* You can easily be in for an interview within a couple days from right now.

### **What You'll Earn**

You'll work a full 40-hour schedule and earn $22-$25 per hour, based on your experience. There's also a $500 bonus opportunity after your New Hire Introductory Period. If you're looking for a role where strong after-hours performance and ServiceTitan expertise can turn into real professional development, that's part of the path here too.

### **Why Work With Us**

This is for people who like ownership, not hand-holding. If you're proactive, transparent, and naturally step in to solve problems, you'll fit right in.

This is not for someone who wants a slow shift, vague expectations, or a team that lets things slide. After-hours work needs sharp communication, consistency, and follow-through.

* Professional Development Opportunities
* Paid Training
* Paid Sick Time
* Paid Holiday Time
* Paid Birthday Time
* Referral Bonuses
* Work with a great team of customer service professionals

### **Who We're Looking For**

You'll likely thrive here if you're already a proven CSR with 2+ years of experience, know ServiceTitan, and genuinely enjoy turning live conversations into booked opportunities. You like fast-moving environments. You care about the customer experience. And you want your work to have a real impact on clients, families, and the communities they serve.

* You have 2+ years of CSR experience
* You have ServiceTitan expertise
* You can commit to the weekly schedule: Monday-Tuesday and Thursday-Friday 3pm-12am and Saturday 11am-8pm EST
* You're a team player with leadership instincts
* You're proactive, transparent, and a problem solver
* You should not apply if you don't want evenings, weekends, or a high-responsibility after-hours environment

If this sounds like your kind of shift, apply now. Strong people get noticed fast, and this team is looking for someone who can own the after-hours experience.

### **Requirements**

* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Work Hours:** 40 to 40 hours work
* **Required Education:** High school or equivalent
* **Required Experience:** Experienced(2) years

jobs.description:
This role is the analytical and systems engine of the MSO Materials & Planning organization. The Manager connects data across ERP, WMS, planning, and finance systems at all MSO manufacturing sites and affiliated entities, turns it into a single trusted view of supply chain performance, and uses that view to drive decisions. The position combines hands-on supply chain expertise with strong systems and analytics capability and leads the department’s adoption of AI (including Claude) to automate reporting and build decision tools for purchasing, manufacturing, and network optimization. Role is trusted source of insight for Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Sales, and Marketing

  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  
  

Data & Systems Integration

Serve as the subject-matter expert for supply chain data across ERP (Infor A+ / AS400, QAD, Nexternal, Etc.), WMS, planning, and reporting systems at all MSO sites and affiliates. Understand how data flows between systems, sites, and the Henry Schein distribution network, and where it breaks.

Own configuration, maintenance, and ongoing optimization of supply chain planning systems, including master data governance and planning parameters (lead times, safety stock, order policies, BOMs/routings, item setup), with routine audits and corrective action.

Build and maintain data dictionaries, validated queries, and reusable data sources so analyses are consistent, repeatable, and traceable to sources.

  
  

KPIs & Performance Management

Define and standardize network KPIs and calculation logic across sites, including OTIF/fill rate, backorders, days-to-stock-out, inventory value and turns, excess & obsolete, forecast accuracy and bias, schedule attainment, supplier OTIF and lead time, and cost/absorption.

Automate recurring weekly and monthly KPI reporting to provide consistent, actionable visibility across the network, replacing manual spreadsheet consolidation.

Lead monthly business reviews covering demand, supply, inventory, and service performance, collaborating closely with sales, marketing, product management, finance, and site leadership to anticipate market trends, customer demand, and product lifecycle changes.

  
  

AI Enablement & Decision Tools

Lead the department’s use of Claude and related AI tools: design, build, test, and maintain Claude skills, scheduled tasks, and connected data sources that automate analyses and recurring reports.

Drive a prioritized pipeline of AI-enabled use cases from idea to production use, with measured business benefit.

Establish guardrails for AI-assisted work: validation of outputs against source data, documentation, and change control. For tools that support QMS-regulated processes, ensure software validation in line with ISO 13485:2016 (clause 4.1.6) and FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820).

Train and coach planners, buyers, and site teams to use AI tools effectively and to build their own; share best practices across sites.

  
  

Supply Chain Strategy & Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Finance on inventory valuation, E&O exposure, standard cost and absorption, and working capital; partner with Sales and Marketing on demand signals, customer service levels, product transitions, and launch/phase-out planning.

Oversee inventory levels and distribution to ensure optimal stock levels while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory. Implement best practices in inventory control and replenishment.

Proactively identify and mitigate supply chain risks, building early-warning alerts and contingency plans to ensure uninterrupted product availability.

Drive a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for enhanced efficiency, cost reduction, and increased customer satisfaction within the MSO organization.

Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required. In addition to the essential duties and responsibilities listed above, all positions are also responsible for meeting company standards pertaining to quantity and quality of work performed on an ongoing basis, performing all work-related tasks in a manner that follows all Company policies and procedures including Worldwide Business Standards.

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  
  

Strong knowledge of supply chain principles: demand and supply planning, MRP, inventory optimization, purchasing, production scheduling, and distribution networks. Manufacturing environment experience preferred.

Hands-on ERP experience (Infor A+ / AS/400, SAP, Oracle, or similar), including working with underlying tables and data structures, not only front-end screens. WMS/MES exposure a plus.

Understanding of systems integration and networks: data flows between systems, interfaces/EDI, APIs, and data quality management.

Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) for analysis or automation. Experience building AI skills, agents, or prompt-driven workflows strongly preferred; candidates without direct experience must demonstrate strong aptitude and the ability to learn quickly.

Ability to translate business questions into data analysis, and analysis back into clear, actionable recommendations for leaders and front-line teams.

Experience in an FDA-regulated / ISO 13485 manufacturing environment preferred.

Proven experience implementing and improving supply chain processes.

  
  

GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

  
  

Strong management and leadership skills and ability to attract, retain, motivate, develop and mentor team members for high performance

Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and ability to resolve disputes effectively

Excellent presentation and public speaking skills

Excellent independent decision making, analysis and problem solving skills

Understand and act on financial information that contributes to business profitability

Ability to plan and manage successful projects; understand available resources, develop timeline, budget, assign tasks and areas of responsibility

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Haven Housing Solutions**

Haven Housing Solutions (HHS) is a turnkey furnished housing company operating in all 50 states. When a family is displaced by a fire, flood, or storm, insurance carriers and their partners call us to get that family into a fully furnished, move in ready home, fast. We also house corporate professionals on assignment and support government agencies. We are lean, we move quickly, we are relationship driven, and we are growing.

**Why This Role**

* **Uncapped commission.** Every placement you close pays you. No cap, no ceiling.
* **Six figure earning potential.** Base salary plus commission, with top performers clearing six figures.
* **Fully remote, flexible hours.** Work from home on a flexible schedule.
* **A real path up.** We promote from within. Prove it here and grow into a Team Lead, and leadership roles as HHS scales.
* **A modern sales stack.** Salesforce, M365, AI tools, and automation built to keep you selling instead of doing busy work.
* **Work that matters.** Every deal you close puts a displaced family into a home during one of the hardest weeks of their lives.

**What You Will Do**

* Prospect and cold call insurance adjusters, claims teams, third party administrators, and public adjusters to open new accounts and grow existing ones.
* Run outbound sequences in Salesforce and build relationships that turn into repeat business.
* Work incoming housing requests fast: review options, negotiate with landlords and property managers, and build tiered quotes that win.
* Present options quickly, handle objections, and close the placement.
* Coordinate tours, collect lease details, and hand off cleanly to our Customer Care team for move in.
* Keep every account, contact, and deal accurate and current in Salesforce.
* Use AI every day to research accounts, prep for calls, draft outreach, and move faster.
* Hit and beat your monthly placement and revenue targets.

**What You Must Bring**

* 2+ years of cold calling and outbound sales experience with a track record of hitting or beating quota.
* Hands on Salesforce experience: managing a pipeline, logging activity, and working from reports.
* Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, or Grok, and the drive to keep getting better with them.
* Commission motivation: you want your income tied to your results.
* Clear, confident, professional written and verbal English; you will speak daily with insurance professionals daily.
* Self-starter who manages a full pipeline without being chased.
* Authorized to work in the US, with a quiet home office and reliable high-speed internet.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in insurance housing, ALE, corporate housing, relocation, property management, real estate, or insurance claims.
* Experience with Dialpad or a similar VoIP dialer, and Microsoft 365.
* Experience with Salesforce Cadences or another sales engagement tool.

**No housing experience? No problem.** We will teach you the industry. You bring the sales drive.

**Is This You?**

**You will thrive here if**:

* Money motivates you and you want to be paid for performance.
* You would rather make one more call than leave a deal on the table.
* You track your own numbers and push to beat them.
* You want a seat that grows as the company grows.

**This is not the role for you if** you want the same paycheck regardless of results, you avoid the phone, or you need someone telling you what to do next.

**Compensation and Benefits**

**Pay range**: $80,000 to $130,000+ per year (base salary plus uncapped commission)

* Base salary plus uncapped commission on every placement you close.
* Performance bonuses on top of commission for high volume months.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid time off and company holidays.
* Fully remote with flexible working hours.
* Ongoing training in Salesforce, AI tools, and the insurance housing market.
* A clear advancement path for top performers.

Full compensation details are shared during the interview process.

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume with a short note answering these two questions:

* What was your best month in outbound sales, and what drove it?
* How do you use AI in your sales workflow today?

**Applications without answers to both questions will not be considered.**

Haven Housing Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

At Storable, we're redefining property management for specialty real estate. The ideal candidate has experience managing a portfolio of clients in a SaaS, insurance, risk, or storage-related environment. You build trusted partnerships, turn account insights into action, and create predictable, long-term value for partners and Storable.

**Job Description:**

Are you technically minded, detail-oriented, and interested in helping customers successfully implement and connect new technology? CSI is seeking a **Technical Implementation Specialist** to support the hands-on installation, configuration, integration, deployment, and validation of CSI software for new and existing customers. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys a blend of **technical implementation, SQL, data integration, troubleshooting, and customer interaction**. You’ll work with technical environments, databases, data exchanges, connectivity, APIs, and system interfaces while partnering with customers and internal teams to ensure successful implementations.

**In This Role**

You’ll be responsible for accurately and efficiently completing assigned technical implementation activities using established processes and procedures. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, validate data and integrations, support deployments and go-lives, and escalate more complex issues when needed.

**What You’ll Do**

* Perform technical environment setup and standard software installation and configuration.
* Build, run, and validate flat-file extracts based on defined specifications.
* Verify record counts, file layouts, and data quality before delivery.
* Run SQL queries and scripts to validate, troubleshoot, and correct converted data.
* Assist with configuring, testing, and validating file-based and API integrations between CSI solutions and customer or third-party systems.

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in technical implementation, systems administration, data integration, technical support, or a comparable technical role.

jobs.title: Customer Success Executive
jobs.description:
Overview:

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

HealthEdge's customer success strategy depends on four organizational capabilities: achieving customer outcomes, retaining and converting referenceable customers, expanding revenue within the existing customer base, and maintaining data and reporting integrity. The CSE is an essential delivery partner in all four — owning defined workstreams, managing critical relationship layers, and keeping the operational machinery of customer success running with precision.

This is not a support role. It is an outcome ownership role at a defined scope. A CSE at HealthEdge is accountable for the workstreams they own within the customer's success plan — and for keeping those workstreams current, honest, and moving without being asked.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Responsibilities are organized by the four strategic outcomes the CSE organization exists to deliver. These are not task lists — they are outcome areas with clear accountability.

**Customer Outcomes**

* Own defined workstreams within the Customer Success Plan for every assigned account — keeping your sections current, evidence-based, and tied to the customer's business objectives, not HealthEdge's delivery milestones.
* Support the Senior CSE in quarterbacking execution across Delivery, Operations, Technology, and Product. Own every task you've been assigned until it is closed — not until you've sent it to someone else.
* Understand the HealthEdge platform capabilities relevant to your assigned accounts well enough to support executive preparation and translate delivery activity into customer language.

**Customer Retention &** **Referenceability**

* Surface account risk before the customer does — identify the signal, act on it, and flag it appropriately with context already framed: what you're seeing, why it matters, and what you recommend.
* Own assigned pieces of the Path to Green plan for every at-risk account — keep the issue list current and honest, track every action to closure, and never let a recovery item die in a seam.
* Support reference-development plans by maintaining strong VP/Director relationships that make customers willing, credible advocates.

**Customer Revenue Expansion**

* Maintain a current view of each assigned customer's strategic direction and flag multi-product or cross-sell signals to the Senior CSE with context — what you heard, from whom, and what it might mean commercially.
* Know the basics of each assigned account's contract — what was bought, key SLAs, renewal timing — well enough to recognize when an operational issue has client implications and flag it immediately.
* Support clean handoffs to Sales when expansion opportunities are identified — nothing falls in the seam.

**Data & Reporting Discipline**

* Keep health scoring, CRM records, and success plans accurate, complete, and current — audit-ready at all times.
* Contribute to consolidated reporting that gives leadership a trusted single source of truth.
* Flag data gaps or health score discrepancies proactively — don't let a reporting issue become a surprise.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in health plan operations or an adjacent healthcare role. Direct customer-facing experience — account management, implementation support, or customer service — with at least one example of owning an issue end to end.

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

Every shipment eventually hits a moment that isn't in the SOP — a failed carrier connection, an oversized load with no obvious coverage, a customer who needs a straight answer under pressure. Have you ever sat through a training and thought, *"That was amazing. I actually learned something."* Or maybe you've had the opposite experience and found yourself thinking, *"There has to be a better way to teach this."*

  

Do you enjoy taking complex information and turning it into something people can actually understand, remember, and use? Do you love helping others learn, grow, and succeed? If so, keep reading.

  

Compassion International is looking for a creative, collaborative, and mission-minded Learning & Development Specialist I to support our Global Philanthropic Engagement (GPE) teams. In this role, you'll help create and deliver learning experiences that equip employees to confidently adopt new products, processes, tools, and ways of working, all while helping advance Compassion's mission to release children from poverty in Jesus' name.

  

Working alongside subject matter experts, team leaders, and fellow learning professionals, you'll design engaging experiences that may include virtual training, instructor-led workshops, videos, eLearning, job aids, presentations, and more. You'll also help us better understand the impact of our learning programs through feedback, data, and emerging learning metrics.

  

If you're someone who loves learning, enjoys creating, isn't afraid of a blank PowerPoint slide, and gets excited when someone says, "Can you help us teach this?", we'd love to hear from you.

  

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* Maintain a personal relationship with Jesus Christ, serve as a Christ-like witness, and faithfully support Compassion's ministry through prayer.
* Act as an advocate for children and uphold Compassion's commitment to child protection and dignity.
* Uphold and engage in Compassion's core Cultural Behaviors.
* Partner with subject matter experts, product owners, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deliver learning solutions that support Global Philanthropic Engagement (GPE) products, processes, onboarding programs, and strategic initiatives.
* Facilitate engaging learning experiences through a variety of formats, including virtual, in-person, video-based, and eLearning programs.
* Create training materials such as presentations, job aids, videos, eLearning content, and other learner resources that help employees build knowledge, skills, and confidence.
* Conduct learning needs assessments, identify learning objectives, and evaluate training effectiveness to continuously improve learner outcomes and adoption.
* Gather and analyze learning metrics, feedback, and performance data to help measure learning impact and inform future training strategies.
* Leverage Microsoft Copilot and other AI-enabled tools to improve content development, streamline workflows, enhance learner experiences, and drive innovation in learning solutions.
Build strong partnerships across Compassion while contributing to a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and operational excellence.  

  

**What do you bring?**
----------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Learning & Development, Education, Human Resources, Communications, Business, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Two or more years of experience in learning and development, training, education, communications, customer support, marketing, human resources, or a related field.
* Experience creating learning content such as presentations, videos, eLearning modules, communications, job aids, or other educational resources.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to engage learners in both virtual and in-person settings.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to partner with subject matter experts and translate complex topics into easy-to-understand learning experiences.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and related applications.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new content, tools, and approaches.
* Experience measuring learning effectiveness through feedback, learner assessments, metrics, or performance data preferred.
Experience with eLearning tools, video creation, graphic design, learning management systems (LMS), or AI-enabled productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot is a plus.  

  

**We will be excited if you have:**
-----------------------------------

* Experience in the creative space, whether that’s video creation, photography, graphics, eLearning, written communication or something similar. This job requires a lot of creativity to deliver engaging and effective training!
* Experience working in a call center or in payment processing. The areas this trainer will cover are highly detailed and specific to ensure our Supporters receive world class customer care, so if you have experience in that world already – that’s great!
An understanding of, and even some experience with Compassion. Maybe you’re a sponsor or you even worked as an intern, road rep, event facilitator or something similar.  

  

**Why work here?**

* **The mission:** Join a team that is motivated to release children from poverty in Jesus’ name.
* **Our benefits:** Receive generous paid time off, 10% contribution to a 403(b) retirement fund on top of your salary, excellent healthcare coverage, free short-term professional counseling, and more .
* **Spiritual growth:** Participate in regular chapel services, prayer groups, and department devotionals.

Bill Wilson Center provides services to children, youth, young adults, and families in Santa Clara County. Additionally, we reach clients through our street outreach and crisis line programs. Bill Wilson Center programs focus on housing, mental health care, supportive services, and advocacy. Bill Wilson Center is committed to working with the community to ensure that every youth has access to the range of services needed to grow to be healthy and self-sufficient adults. A key component of Bill Wilson Center's philosophy encompasses a strength-based approach to improving the lives of the youth and young families in our communities. Bill Wilson Center has been providing services to runaway and homeless youth since 1973. Join us and become a difference maker at Bill Wilson Center!

new_jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager – Interiors and Clinical Environment Standards
new_jobs.description:
The Senior Program Manager – Interiors and Clinical Environment Standards manages the development, governance, continuous improvement, and oversight of the UCSF Health Interiors and Clinical Environment Standards Program under the direction of the Health Major Capital Director of of Project Delivery and in collaboration with the UCSF Campus Architect. This role serves as the enterprise-wide subject matter expert for healthcare interiors, clinical environment planning, and design standards, influencing the planning and design of capital projects across UCSF Health.

  

A significant responsibility of this position is front-end planning for new outpatient clinics, hospitals, inpatient units, and other clinical care environments. Working with clinical and operational leadership, capital planning, architects, clinical planners, equipment planners, and other stakeholders, the Senior Program Manager helps translate models of care, operational requirements, patient and staff needs, and institutional priorities into physical planning and design criteria. Early involvement helps establish consistent planning principles before project-specific design solutions are developed.

  

The program encompasses interior design standards and standardized clinical planning criteria for inpatient and outpatient care environments, including clinical room templates, room configurations and layouts, equipment and furniture standards, casework and storage, interior finishes and materials, signage, art, and other elements of the built environment. Standards consider clinical workflow, equipment and technology integration, ergonomics, accessibility, infection prevention, safety, sustainability, maintainability, flexibility, patient experience, and efficient use of space.

  

The Senior Program Manager establishes the governance, policies, criteria, and processes through which these standards are developed, approved, applied, and updated. The role provides strategic oversight and subject matter expertise primarily during programming, planning, and design, working with project teams to promote consistency, reduce unnecessary variation, and appropriately apply enterprise standards while accommodating unique clinical and operational requirements.

  

The position establishes healthcare-specific criteria for finishes, furnishings, equipment, art, and signage based on clinical function, aesthetics, sustainability, durability, cleanability, infection prevention, regulatory and building code requirements, ergonomics, safety, lifecycle cost, and patient and staff experience. The role collaborates with architects, designers, furniture and equipment vendors, art consultants, and other industry professionals to develop solutions consistent with UCSF Health standards and its mission to provide advanced, effective, and human-centered healthcare environments.

  

Management of the program includes maintaining standards and clinical planning templates; establishing stakeholder and user-input processes; providing quality assurance during planning and design; reporting to appropriate governance structures; and administering a formal exception process when project-specific clinical, operational, regulatory, or physical conditions require deviation from established standards. The Senior Program Manager also works with established organizational partners and governance groups, including the Art Committee, Signage Committee, UCSF Interior Design Standards website development group, and University Development and Alumni Relations (UDAR) for donor recognition standards.

  

These responsibilities extend across UCSF Health's capital portfolio, including Health Major Capital Projects, Health Design and Construction Projects, and Health Small Projects. The program currently influences three approved major capital programs totaling approximately $7 billion, approximately 100 Health Design and Construction projects totaling $200 million, and approximately 150 Health Small Project work orders annually totaling $5 million. Through this enterprise-wide responsibility, the Senior Program Manager helps ensure UCSF Health facilities are planned around consistent, scalable standards that support clinical care, operational efficiency, patient experience, staff effectiveness, and long-term facility performance.

  

**Department Description**

The organization of UCSF Real Estate is focused on the development, planning, delivery, and management of physical space for UCSF. Key responsibilities include a unified approach to oversee the active UCSF growth planned on a multi-site campus and to manage the complex metropolitan environments affecting capital assets and projects and efforts to align municipal challenges with maximum effectiveness in support of the UCSF mission.

  

UCSF Real Estate is an integrated unit that enables the alignment of development, planning, design, construction, and management of facilities and a lease portfolio of 1M square feet across UCSF. Services are provided through the following departments: Building Permit Services, Campus Design and Construction, Campus Planning, Construction Contract Administration, Health Design and Construction, Health Major Capital Projects, Real Estate Services, Benioff Children’s Hospital Oakland Capital Program Management and support through Business Intelligence, and Finance, Administration and Operations.

  

The Health Major Capital Project Department is responsible for delivering the design and construction of new buildings and other major capital projects as assigned. Typical project budgets are hundreds of millions of dollars. Our goals are delivered through Integrated Project Delivery (IPD) methodologies. Current project delivery methods include an IFOA contract. Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

#### **About This Role**

Dutchie is the leading technology platform powering the cannabis industry. Our Brands team is the connective tissue between cannabis brands and the thousands of dispensaries that carry, merchandise, and advertise their products. As the Brand Ops Manager, you will own the day-to-day operational relationship with our brand advertising customers, from onboarding through campaign launch and optimization. You will work side by side with our Ad Sales team, who are the primary drivers of new business and expansion, and your work supports those efforts.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for someone who combines campaign execution with sharp business judgment. Your primary mandate is to onboard new advertisers, configure their campaigns in Kevel, our ad serving platform, manage performance against each brand’s goals and retail and grow revenue via strategic campaign management. You will then turn campaign data into a clear narrative that you share with the customer, one that influences strategic changes to their approach and gives the Ad Sales team the insight to support upsell and expansion. In a single day you might lead an onboarding call, build a flight in Kevel, adjust bids and budgets across a portfolio of campaigns, and prepare a business review that connects ad performance to a brand’s revenue goals.

You will partner closely with the Ad Sales team and work alongside R&D and Analytics, representing the voice of the customer and helping shape the advertising products that are still being built. We will teach you the market, and we value strong advertising and customer skills above all. You will also use AI tools every day to work faster, from analysis to automation, and apply careful human judgment to everything they produce. new_jobs.description:
This role is the analytical and systems engine of the MSO Materials & Planning organization. The Manager connects data across ERP, WMS, planning, and finance systems at all MSO manufacturing sites and affiliated entities, turns it into a single trusted view of supply chain performance, and uses that view to drive decisions. The position combines hands-on supply chain expertise with strong systems and analytics capability and leads the department’s adoption of AI (including Claude) to automate reporting and build decision tools for purchasing, manufacturing, and network optimization. Role is trusted source of insight for Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Sales, and Marketing

  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  
  

Data & Systems Integration

Serve as the subject-matter expert for supply chain data across ERP (Infor A+ / AS400, QAD, Nexternal, Etc.), WMS, planning, and reporting systems at all MSO sites and affiliates. Understand how data flows between systems, sites, and the Henry Schein distribution network, and where it breaks.

Own configuration, maintenance, and ongoing optimization of supply chain planning systems, including master data governance and planning parameters (lead times, safety stock, order policies, BOMs/routings, item setup), with routine audits and corrective action.

Build and maintain data dictionaries, validated queries, and reusable data sources so analyses are consistent, repeatable, and traceable to sources.

  
  

KPIs & Performance Management

Define and standardize network KPIs and calculation logic across sites, including OTIF/fill rate, backorders, days-to-stock-out, inventory value and turns, excess & obsolete, forecast accuracy and bias, schedule attainment, supplier OTIF and lead time, and cost/absorption.

Automate recurring weekly and monthly KPI reporting to provide consistent, actionable visibility across the network, replacing manual spreadsheet consolidation.

Lead monthly business reviews covering demand, supply, inventory, and service performance, collaborating closely with sales, marketing, product management, finance, and site leadership to anticipate market trends, customer demand, and product lifecycle changes.

  
  

AI Enablement & Decision Tools

Lead the department’s use of Claude and related AI tools: design, build, test, and maintain Claude skills, scheduled tasks, and connected data sources that automate analyses and recurring reports.

Drive a prioritized pipeline of AI-enabled use cases from idea to production use, with measured business benefit.

Establish guardrails for AI-assisted work: validation of outputs against source data, documentation, and change control. For tools that support QMS-regulated processes, ensure software validation in line with ISO 13485:2016 (clause 4.1.6) and FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820).

Train and coach planners, buyers, and site teams to use AI tools effectively and to build their own; share best practices across sites.

  
  

Supply Chain Strategy & Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Finance on inventory valuation, E&O exposure, standard cost and absorption, and working capital; partner with Sales and Marketing on demand signals, customer service levels, product transitions, and launch/phase-out planning.

Oversee inventory levels and distribution to ensure optimal stock levels while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory. Implement best practices in inventory control and replenishment.

Proactively identify and mitigate supply chain risks, building early-warning alerts and contingency plans to ensure uninterrupted product availability.

Drive a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for enhanced efficiency, cost reduction, and increased customer satisfaction within the MSO organization.

Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required. In addition to the essential duties and responsibilities listed above, all positions are also responsible for meeting company standards pertaining to quantity and quality of work performed on an ongoing basis, performing all work-related tasks in a manner that follows all Company policies and procedures including Worldwide Business Standards.

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  
  

Strong knowledge of supply chain principles: demand and supply planning, MRP, inventory optimization, purchasing, production scheduling, and distribution networks. Manufacturing environment experience preferred.

Hands-on ERP experience (Infor A+ / AS/400, SAP, Oracle, or similar), including working with underlying tables and data structures, not only front-end screens. WMS/MES exposure a plus.

Understanding of systems integration and networks: data flows between systems, interfaces/EDI, APIs, and data quality management.

Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) for analysis or automation. Experience building AI skills, agents, or prompt-driven workflows strongly preferred; candidates without direct experience must demonstrate strong aptitude and the ability to learn quickly.

Ability to translate business questions into data analysis, and analysis back into clear, actionable recommendations for leaders and front-line teams.

Experience in an FDA-regulated / ISO 13485 manufacturing environment preferred.

Proven experience implementing and improving supply chain processes.

  
  

GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

  
  

Strong management and leadership skills and ability to attract, retain, motivate, develop and mentor team members for high performance

Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and ability to resolve disputes effectively

Excellent presentation and public speaking skills

Excellent independent decision making, analysis and problem solving skills

Understand and act on financial information that contributes to business profitability

Ability to plan and manage successful projects; understand available resources, develop timeline, budget, assign tasks and areas of responsibility
