new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Are you technically minded, detail-oriented, and interested in helping customers successfully implement and connect new technology? CSI is seeking a **Technical Implementation Specialist** to support the hands-on installation, configuration, integration, deployment, and validation of CSI software for new and existing customers. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys a blend of **technical implementation, SQL, data integration, troubleshooting, and customer interaction**. You’ll work with technical environments, databases, data exchanges, connectivity, APIs, and system interfaces while partnering with customers and internal teams to ensure successful implementations.

**In This Role**

You’ll be responsible for accurately and efficiently completing assigned technical implementation activities using established processes and procedures. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, validate data and integrations, support deployments and go-lives, and escalate more complex issues when needed.

**What You’ll Do**

* Perform technical environment setup and standard software installation and configuration.
* Build, run, and validate flat-file extracts based on defined specifications.
* Verify record counts, file layouts, and data quality before delivery.
* Run SQL queries and scripts to validate, troubleshoot, and correct converted data.
* Assist with configuring, testing, and validating file-based and API integrations between CSI solutions and customer or third-party systems.
* Troubleshoot installation, connectivity, file-transfer, data, and configuration issues and escalate more complex problems when needed.
* Support deployment and go-live activities, including cutover tasks and post-deployment validation.
* Deploy code, configuration packages, or releases to test environments when required by the solution or implementation process.
* Document technical configurations, file specifications, testing results, and issue-resolution steps.
* Communicate directly with customer technical contacts while working with senior team members and internal partners.
* Stay current on relevant CSI products, technical standards, and product enhancements.
* Travel as needed to support customer implementations and business needs.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What We’re Looking For**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in technical implementation, systems administration, data integration, technical support, or a comparable technical role.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience or familiarity with secure file transfer and file-based data formats.
* Understanding of server operating environments and network connectivity.
* Familiarity with APIs and system integrations is beneficial.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to follow technical specifications and established implementation procedures while recognizing when an issue should be escalated.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with data conversions, integrations, and validation.
* Ability to communicate technical information effectively with customers and internal teams.
* Education or job knowledge equivalent to an undergraduate education in a technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience or certifications.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role**

* You enjoy getting into the technical details and figuring out why something isn't working.
* You're comfortable working with data, SQL, files, integrations, connectivity, and system configurations.
* You can follow a defined process while still using critical thinking to identify potential issues.
* You're organized and comfortable balancing multiple implementation tasks and deadlines.
* You communicate well with both technical teams and customers.
* You're eager to continue developing your technical knowledge and grow into increasingly complex implementation work.

new_jobs.title: Operations Specialist II, Lifesciences (US)
new_jobs.description:
### **Company Introduction:**

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

**Own the Judgment Calls That Keep Orders Moving**
--------------------------------------------------

Every shipment eventually hits a moment that isn't in the SOP — a failed carrier connection, an oversized load with no obvious coverage, a customer who needs a straight answer under pressure. As an Operations Specialist II, you're the person who resolves that moment without waiting for someone else to tell you how.

You've mastered the OS I fundamentals and are now trusted to act on incomplete information, source coverage other people can't, and de-escalate situations independently. This is where reactive execution starts becoming proactive ownership.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

*Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist I job description, in addition to the following:*

### **Resolve What Doesn't Fit the Standard Playbook**

* Independently start carrier traces for failed-to-load or unable-to-locate shipments
* Source driver coverage for any segment of an order, including oversized shipments
* Use bid/quote request tools to source specialized vehicles and provide cost estimates to customers
* Apply training and tenured knowledge to anticipate complications and proactively solve for them

### **Exercise Independent Judgment**

* De-escalate most situations without assistance
* Know when to escalate an order versus independently resolving it using available resources
* Understand the downstream impact of decisions made within an order

### **Communicate Proactively and Strengthen the Platform**

* Communicate proactively — not just reactively — with customers, drivers, and agents at every step of the shipment process
* Maintain any certifications required for your assigned sector and stay current on related compliance requirements
* Identify and suggest system features or workflow improvements that would help Operations

### **Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance**

As an OS II, you'll be expected to meet minimum metric requirements and customer service standards appropriate for this level. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor. Expectations increase with each advancement.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* Demonstrated success as an Operations Specialist I, or equivalent time-critical logistics / customer operations experience
* Proven ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information and under time pressure
* Track record of de-escalating difficult customer or operational situations without needing to hand it off
* Comfort sourcing non-standard solutions (specialized vehicles, oversized loads) rather than defaulting to escalation
* Any certifications required for your assigned sector (e.g., Dangerous Goods handling, where applicable), or willingness to obtain them
* Continued availability to work the shift pattern required by your team

  

**Advancement to Operations Specialist III**
--------------------------------------------

To advance to OS III, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

* Minimum of 6-12 months in the OS II role
* Consistently meeting or exceeding OS II performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed across two consecutive Semi-Annual Reviews (SARs)
* Demonstrated advanced problem-solving proficiency — independently resolving escalations rather than routing them upward
* Working understanding of margin and cost tradeoffs as they relate to order decisions
* Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to operate as an escalation point for the team

  

**Compensation**

* Hourly pay range: $22-26/hr
* High-quality health, vision, and dental care plan options
* 401K company contribution program
* Professional learning and training reimbursements

### **Core Values:**

* **We are One Team**. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
* **We make an Impact**. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
* **We are Passionate**. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
* **We are Transparent**. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
* **We are Innovative**. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

new_jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
new_jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose: economic empowerment. We build technology that increases access and independence for sellers, individuals, and artists around the world. Working at Block means working on and across our brands—Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Spiral, and Proto— in roles that connect, enable, and push all of them forward faster.

We’re remote-first by design and operate with intelligence at the center of everything we do. At Block, you'll be challenged by some of the brightest, most creative minds in the industry and have the tools and autonomy to do the most meaningful work of your career.

#### **The Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Sales Compensation Operations Analyst to independently lead complex commissions administration across multiple plans and sales populations. You’ll own end-to-end commission cycles, resolve complex operational issues, and strengthen the controls and processes behind accurate, timely payments.

As a senior individual contributor, you’ll partner with Finance, Payroll, Sales Operations, HR, and technical teams to drive improvements, support approved plan changes, and develop the team’s operational expertise. This role owns the administration of approved sales compensation plans, not sales compensation plan design.

#### **You Will**

* Independently own end-to-end commission cycles across multiple plans and sales populations, managing timelines, dependencies, approvals, and validated payment submissions to Payroll.
* Interpret and apply approved plan rules for participant eligibility, quotas, sales crediting, effective dates, and adjustments; oversee accurate plan assignments and participant changes.
* Own complex reconciliations across sales transactions, commission calculations, adjustments, and payment totals, resolving discrepancies before payment submission.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex commission inquiries, explain calculations and outcomes clearly, and coordinate resolution within approved policies. Document exceptions and secure required approvals.
* Design and strengthen operational controls, review procedures, and audit documentation to improve accuracy, consistency, and traceability.
* Lead root-cause analysis of recurring issues and use operational reporting to prioritize improvements that reduce errors, manual work, and payment risk.
* Lead operational readiness and user acceptance testing for approved plan, process, and system changes, partnering with technical teams to define requirements, validate results, and resolve issues.
* Mentor teammates, guide complex cases, and improve shared procedures and training materials to strengthen team capability and consistency.

#### **You Have**

* 5+ years of experience in sales compensation, commissions administration, or related operations.
* Demonstrated experience in sales commissions administration, including independent ownership of complex payment cycles across multiple plans or sales populations.
* Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, including advanced formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliation of large datasets.
* Ability to interpret complex compensation plan rules, investigate discrepancies, and distinguish routine administration decisions from exceptions requiring approval.
* Experience developing operational controls, supporting audits, and leading process improvements through implementation.
* Experience translating business requirements into test scenarios, validating results, and assessing readiness for plan, process, or system changes.
* Strong cross-functional communication and influencing skills, including explaining sensitive payment issues and resolving competing priorities.
* Sound judgment, discretion with confidential compensation information, and the ability to manage ambiguity while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

#### **Nice to Have**

* Experience administering incentive compensation platforms, such as Pigment, Xactly, CaptivateIQ, or Spiff.
* SQL skills for querying, validating, and analyzing commission-related data.

#### **Technologies We Use and Teach**

* Pigment for ICM/quota issuance, Salesforce as the system of record & end user UI in Looker.

Dudek’s journey began in 1980 with a vision to serve Southern California’s water and wastewater agencies.

new_jobs.description:
About This Position

Full-time remote insurance role working with households who requested a coverage review. As a Retirement Solutions Account Manager, you look at the policies a client has now, recommend coverage that supports their plans, and help them complete the application. You stay with each client until the decision is made.

Your pay is commission based and rises with each application you complete. The schedule is full-time. Hours are self-set, though meetings take place when households can attend, so account managers typically keep steady weekday hours and offer some early evening times. You are supported by trainers who know the work firsthand.

What You'll Do

* Meet by phone or video with households who requested a review
* Gather details about existing policies and the plans each household has
* Recommend insurance coverage suited to each client's goals
* Help clients weigh the choices and settle on one
* With the client on the line, complete the application and submit it promptly
* Follow up after submission and at agreed check-in dates

Who Fits

* Prior work in account management, sales, or advising is a real advantage
* You look forward to joining the training and education program
* You explain coverage in simple terms and keep each conversation on course
* Consistent about daily activity and keeping client records current
* Comfortable recommending a course of action and asking for a decision
* Home office space that is quiet and suitable for client calls

What's Provided

* Warm leads supplied by the team, all from people who asked for a review
* Training and education on presenting insurance coverage and completing applications
* Commission based income with bonus tiers for high producers
* Ongoing coaching from trainers who have done this work
* Flexibility to plan your week around client meetings

Pay: $70,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote
